steps: PARENT-BINDING
Bind accepted Batch 523-534 archive, console and unchanged historical signal receipt before repository work.
FIXTURE-PROVENANCE
Accept only issued, explicitly scripted text fixtures; never a live provider result or transcription claim.
CONTEXT-BINDING
Bind each simulation to an issued current review preview and its exact attachment/text revision.
BOUNDED-JOBS
At most sixteen active jobs per controller, one pending job per transcript and one final result per job.
EXPLICIT-LIFECYCLE
Queue, start and result-delivery transitions are caller-invoked pure simulation operations; no provider or background worker.
CANCEL-AND-DISCARD
Cancellation and discard invalidate pending and quarantined results and release controller-owned content references.
SIMULATED-EXPIRY
Nonnegative monotonic caller-supplied ticks model a 60000-tick lifetime; no live clock, timer or real-time deadline guarantee.
STALE-RESULT-REJECTION
Text edits, attachment revision changes and source-review discard invalidate pending results before admission.
RESULT-QUARANTINE
Result tickets carry no transcript text or execution approval and cannot be forged by copying or moved between controllers.
FRESH-REVIEW
Explicit one-use admission creates a separate draft review. Prior preview approval does not authorize the result or any action.
STATIC-PRESENTATION
Present lifecycle boundaries under an accessible heading; introduce no active application input, media or processing control.
VERIFICATION-ACCEPTANCE
Verify exact payload, full frontend suite, two deterministic builds and discovery; publish with exact lease and preserve evidence.
title: Scripted processing lifecycle and stale-result quarantine
